properties.evidence: Corroboration, not conflict. The 2026-08-28 record wrote up the first time fact:the-storage-seam-is-published-in-design-and-private-in-code misled a reader into reporting a live design-vs-code defect in this repo, and closed by saying it was not known whether this is a class. This is the same fact catching a second reader 16 days later, by the identical route. It confirms that record's central claim and answers half of its open question: the particular node reliably misleads, while whether OTHER retired-dependency facts do the same is still unestablished. It also shows the write-up itself did not prevent the recurrence.
